newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices extend gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices extend gains.

text.p: Indian cotton prices extended gains on Thursday on low new crop arrivals and continued mill buying, dealers said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi rose by five rupees at 785/825 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned gained by 10 rupees at 1,410/1,630 rupees per maund.
F-414 rose by 15/20 rupees to 1,850/1,870 rupees per maund.

"Arrivals in the Punjab region remained low as farmers were bringing limited quantities at lower level, as well as amid expectation that they may get higher prices if the government allowed more exports," one trader said.
Arrivals in the Punjab region remained low at 15,000/20,000 bales (170 kg each).
